text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Maltese language in state of disaster. Prime Minister promises legislation to protect and promote the use of the Maltese language.

- Surgeon claims political discrimination, says he had planned to contest Oct 26 elections but told his civil service employment prevented him from doing so. Another person in a higher grade been allowed to go ahead, he said.
- Former prime minister Don Mintoff, 80, to stand for election again.
- Labour leader Alfred Sant promises good future for small self-employed. Says removal of VAT and other incentives would take the self-employed out of uncertainty faced under present government.
- Prime Minister Fenech Adami urges voters to compare his government's nine-year record with 16 years of Labour Party rule.
